# Hang Seng Internet & Information Technology Index 

September 2026 

Hang Seng Internet & Information Technology Index ("HSIII") aims to reflect the overall performance of stocks listed in Hong Kong that are related to internet and information technology businesses. 

# FEATURES 

The HSIII includes Hang Seng Composite Index constituents that are classified under Software Services sector 

> ■

Constituents are freefloat-adjusted for investability representation 

> ■

Capping is applied to avoid single stock domination 

> ■

# INFORMATION 

Launch Date 17 Aug 2015 

Backdated To 5 Mar 2010 

Base Date 5 Mar 2010 

Base Index 3,000 

Review Half-yearly 

Dissemination Every 2 sec 

Currency HKD 

Total Return Index Available 

No. of Constituents 30 

# VENDOR CODES

Refinitiv .HSIII
